reviewCoordinatorRole: Vaporize Support DocC machine visual-review coordinator
productIntent: An operator under build pressure can open Vaporize Support, recognize the exact support decision, start with small observations, and prepare evidence without confusing Xcode selection, Swift selection, source materialization, installed runtime, or human approval.

testCases.title: Reader can identify the support task and its authority boundary
testCases.procedure: Open the non-redirecting Vaporize Support DocC root and inspect the visible title, opening purpose, four Start Here routes, and support-boundary language.
testCases.expectedOutcome: The initial viewport communicates evidence-aware support rather than an install or approval action, and exposes the focused triage paths without looking like an unfinished engineering note.

testCases.title: Transparent page identity makes evidence states distinct without decoration
testCases.procedure: Inspect the desktop root for a dominant reader task, restrained DocC chrome, a visible transparent hero, and structural evidence roles that do not rely on text embedded inside the art or color alone.
testCases.expectedOutcome: The root is deliberate and legible: the support purpose, hero topology, semantic alt text, and Start Here paths form a coherent hierarchy with no opaque backplate, generic placeholder, clipped diagram, or accidental overlay.

testCases.title: DocC root and small reader viewport retain the support task
testCases.procedure: Inspect the generated `/documentation/index/` root at the mobile viewport for a missing-page state, missing hero, clipped title or support copy, accidental overlap, horizontal overflow, or console errors.
testCases.expectedOutcome: The generated DocC root resolves the support surface and retains readable primary content, visible identity art, and usable Start Here paths without horizontal overflow. Light and dark source witnesses remain separately recorded because this runner version does not model browser appearance profiles.
testCases.edgeCondition: At a 390px viewport the Documentation root must still load the page title, hero, and primary support routes. The machine capture cannot relabel a source SVG transparency check as a dark-appearance visual review.
